name: bzead-india-android
description: Capacitor Android shell for BZEAD India (com.bzead.india). Wraps the web build from ../dist-buyer-in.

scripts.release:prepare: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.build:release: cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease && cd .. && mkdir -p build-output && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk build-output/BZEAD-India.apk && cp android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab build-output/BZEAD-India.aab
